Preserve failed/exploratory runs; stop on unexplained product integrity failures or resource limits
Run targeted checks and clean-commit full check, ordinary build and smoke
Return the review package, then stop for review before optimization or another phase

Commit, parent, tree and timestamp metadata without personal author information
Full file-hash inventory for tested source, tests, fixtures, configuration and lockfile

out_of_scope: Sampling, protocol, scheduling, subscription order or error propagation changes
UI throttling, runtime extraction or performance optimization

Super App code, shared cloud services or user data uploads
